headlines.title: Union Pacific CEO makes case for $85B Norfolk Southern merger amid pushback
headlines.summary: Union Pacific seeks to acquire Norfolk Southern in an $85 billion deal creating a transcontinental railroad, but some labor unions and farm groups are pushing back.

headlines.title: Earnings Preview: What to Expect From Union Pacific’s Report
headlines.summary: Union Pacific is gearing up to report its third-quarter results later this month, with Wall Street expecting low-double-digit growth in its earnings.

headlines.title: Major chemical producer backs UP-NS merger
headlines.summary: A major chemical producer boosted the UP-NS merger, saying the proposed transcon will help it reach eastern markets. The post Major chemical producer backs UP-NS merger appeared first on FreightWaves.

headlines.title: Three new directors elected to Scoular’s Board of Directors
headlines.summary: New Board Members New Board Members Omaha, Nebraska, Oct. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Scoular shareholders on Tuesday elected three new members to the company’s Board of Directors. They are Diane Duren, a retired Union Pacific executive and Omaha community leader; Stephanie Harlan, entrepreneur, business consultant and daughter of former Scoular CEO Neal Harlan; and Tom Werner, the former CEO of Lamb Weston.

headlines.title: ‘Higher rates, less reliable service’: Family farmers oppose rail merger
headlines.summary: National Farmers Union cites higher costs, less reliability of past rail mergers. The post ‘Higher rates, less reliable service’: Family farmers oppose rail merger appeared first on FreightWaves.

description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
